verdict: REJECT THE DISLOCATION — but explicitly NOT a quality verdict and emphatically not a short (blue SUSTAINED red on a corrected basis, 8/10). The business is uncontestedly healthy and the cash unencumbered; what dies is the CLAIM OF DISCOUNT. Both admission tickets are artifacts: the drawdown round-tripped 49% off a 10x-EV/S peak, so it measures the deflation of a bubble multiple rather than a de-rating of a good business. Corrected earnings base ~$50M FY26 GAAP operating income = ~63x taxed / 23.5x EV/FCF. THE FINDING NEITHER BENCH HAD, and it is the decisive one for this lane: 61% of revenue is non-USD and 3pts of the headline growth is FX — constant-currency growth is ~19-20%, which converts 'cheap-ish' to 'fairly priced' with no other change. Red's structural-retention-leak kill was itself overturned (GRR 88->89->89 against a DISCLOSED sunsetting-product mix headwind; ex-headwind ~91% and improving).
lane: quality_drawdown (first courts ever run from this lane)
reopen_gates: NONE at tape. Price gate ARMED at <=$10.50 (~4.0x EV/S, ~19x EV/FCF, ~1.0x below the H1 buyback's own average cost) — deliberately ABOVE red's $9.50, which was the harshest of five framings and a ~28% air-pocket unlikely absent a guide miss, i.e. a gate that could never fill. Routed to the quality_drawdown watchlist as a TINA/fair-value core-sleeve candidate AT THE GATE, not a court-advanced dislocation. Retention >=93% and SaaS re-acceleration >30% are WATCH triggers, never entry gates.
